blocks.text: Yeh chapter 11 (Human Circulatory System) ke poore chapter se practice short questions (mukhtasar sawal) hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein, Board ke 2 number wale sawal ke andaz mein. Har sawal ka mukhtasar model jawab hai; chhote numericals mein hal ke qadam hain, aur farq wale sawal ka jawab table mein hai.
11.1 Structure and functioning of the heart

blocks.prompt:
1 What is blood? Name its two main components with their share by volume.
(Khoon kya hai? Is ke do bare ajza aur hajm mein un ka hissa batayein.)
blocks.explanation: Khoon woh medium hai jis mein ghuli hui ghiza, gases, hormones aur fuzlaat poore jism mein le jaye jate hain. Is ke ajza: plasma (hajm ka taqreeban 55%) aur cells ya cell jaise ajsam yani white blood cells, red blood cells aur platelets (taqreeban 45%).

book_ref.quote: It is composed of two main components (i) plasma

blocks.prompt:
2 Give reason: the heart is usually felt on the left side although it lies in the middle of the chest.
(Wajah batayein: dil seene ke darmiyan hone ke bawajood aam tor par baayen taraf mehsoos hota hai.)
blocks.explanation: Dil seene ke darmiyan phephron ke beech hai, magar is ka baayan hissa zyada taqatwar aur bara hai kyun ke yeh poore jism ko khoon pump karta hai. Is liye dharkan baayen taraf zyada mehsoos hoti hai; baayan phephra chhota hai aur us mein dil ke liye cardiac notch hai.

book_ref.quote: The heart is usually felt to be on the left side

blocks.prompt:
3 What is pericardium? Name its layers.
(Pericardium kya hai? Is ki tehon ke naam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pericardium dil ko gherne wali theli hai jo use aas paas ke aaza se alag karti hai. Tehein: bahari fibrous pericardium (mazboot connective tissue) aur andaruni serous pericardium, jis ki bahari teh parietal pericardium aur andaruni visceral pericardium (epicardium) hai.

book_ref.quote: Pericardium separates heart from surrounding organs.

blocks.prompt:
4 Where is pericardial fluid found? Write its functions.
(Pericardial fluid kahan hota hai? Is ke kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Pericardial fluid (50 mL tak) pericardial cavity mein hota hai, jo parietal aur visceral pericardium ke darmiyan ki jagah hai. Yeh dil ko chikna rakhta aur infections se bachata hai.

book_ref.quote: It lubricates heart and protects it from infections.

blocks.prompt:
5 Differentiate between epicardium and endocardium.
(Epicardium aur endocardium mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono dil ki deewar ki tehein hain aur in ke darmiyan myocardium hai.

book_ref.quote: The inner layer of pericardium i.e., epicardium makes the outer lining of heart wall.

rows: Dil ki deewar ki bahari tah
Dil ke chambers ki andaruni tah
Pericardium ki andaruni (visceral) teh
Epithelial cells ki aik teh
Myocardium ke upar
Myocardium ke neeche

blocks.prompt:
6 Differentiate between atria and ventricles.
(Atria aur ventricles mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono dil ke chambers hain.

book_ref.quote: Atria receive blood from body and pass it to ventricles

rows: Upar ke do chambers
Neeche ke do chambers
Patli deewar
Moti deewar
Khoon le kar ventricles ko dete hain
Khoon jism mein bhejte hain
Interatrial septum se alag
Bohat mote interventricular septum se alag

blocks.prompt:
7 Why is the human heart called a double pump?
(Insani dil ko double pump kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Kyun ke yeh do circulations chalata hai: daayan hissa pulmonary circulation (phephron ko khoon) aur baayan hissa systemic circulation (phephron ke siwa tamam aaza ko khoon).

book_ref.quote: Human heart functions as a double pump.

blocks.prompt:
8 Which side of the heart contains oxygenated blood and which side deoxygenated blood?
(Dil ki kis taraf oxygen wala aur kis taraf baghair oxygen ka khoon hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dil ki daayen taraf deoxygenated khoon (jism se aa kar phephron ko jata) aur baayen taraf oxygenated khoon (phephron se aa kar jism ko jata) hota hai. Dono ko mukammal alag rakha jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Complete separation of deoxygenated (right side) and oxygenated (left side) blood is maintained in heart.

blocks.prompt:
9 Define cardiac cycle. How long does each part of it last?
(Cardiac cycle ki definition likhein. Is ka har hissa kitni der ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Dil ke chambers ka baari baari dheela hona aur sukarna mil kar cardiac cycle ya aik dharkan kehlata hai. Diastole taqreeban 0.4 second, atrial systole 0.1 second aur ventricular systole 0.3 second ka hota hai.

book_ref.quote: Its alternating relaxations and contractions are collectively called a cardiac cycle

blocks.prompt:
10 Differentiate between 'lubb' and 'dubb' sounds of the heart.
(Dil ki 'lubb' aur 'dubb' awazon mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono dil ki awazein hain jo stethoscope se suni jati hain.

book_ref.quote: When both ventricles contract simultaneously to pump the blood

rows: Tricuspid aur bicuspid valves band hone par
Pulmonary aur aortic semilunar valves band hone par
Dono ventricles ke sukarne par (ventricular systole ki shuruat)
Ventricular systole khatam ho kar ventricles dheele hone par

blocks.prompt:
11 What is a heart murmur? How are serious cases corrected?
(Heart murmur kya hai? Sanjeeda surat ko kaise theek kiya jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Agar dil ke valves poore band na hon ya tang khulen to dil mein turbulence paida hoti hai jo murmur ki shakal mein sunai deti hai, jaise sar sar (hiss). Sanjeeda murmurs kharab valves ko masnooi ya donor ke valves se badal kar theek kiye jate hain.

book_ref.quote: This turbulence can be heard as a heart murmur.

blocks.prompt:
12 What is the SA node? Why is it called the pacemaker?
(SA node kya hai? Ise pacemaker kyun kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Sinoatrial (SA) node cardiac muscle cells ka chhota guchha hai jo daayen atrium ki upari deewar mein hai. Ise pacemaker kehte hain kyun ke yeh dil ki pumping shuru karta hai: atria ki deewaron ko electrical impulses bhej kar dono atria ko sukarata hai.

book_ref.quote: The pumping of heart is initiated by the Sinoatrial Node (SA node) or pacemaker.

blocks.prompt:
13 What is the bundle of His? Write its role.
(Bundle of His kya hai? Is ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Bundle of His (atrioventricular bundle) interventricular septum mein fibres ka jaal hai. Yeh AV node se impulses le kar baayen aur daayen shakhon mein batt'ta hai jo Purkinje fibres par khatam hoti hain, yun ventricles taqreeban aik saath sukarte hain.

book_ref.quote: From AV node, the impulses reach an atrioventricular bundle or bundle of His.

blocks.prompt:
14 Give reason: impulses are delayed between the SA node and the AV node.
(Wajah batayein: SA node aur AV node ke darmiyan impulses mein takheer hoti hai.)
blocks.explanation: SA node se AV node tak impulse pohanchne mein taqreeban 0.15 second ki takheer hoti hai. Is se atrial systole ventricular systole shuru hone se pehle mukammal ho jata hai, yani ventricles sukarne se pehle bhar jate hain.

book_ref.quote: permitting atrial systole to be completed before ventricular systole begins

blocks.prompt:
15 What is an artificial pacemaker? When is it used?
(Masnooi pacemaker kya hai? Yeh kab istemal hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Masnooi pacemaker battery se chalne wala aala hai jo surgery se jism mein lagaya jata hai. Yeh electrical signals de kar normal dharkan chalata hai. Yeh tab lagta hai jab SA node kamzor ho ya impulses ruk jayein jis se dharkan dheemi ya band ho sakti hai.

book_ref.quote: It emits electrical signals that trigger normal heartbeats.

blocks.prompt:
16 How does the brain change the heart rate?
(Dimagh dil ki raftar kaise badalta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Normal raftar (taqreeban 70 fi minute) pacemaker aur AV node qaim rakhte hain. Bukhar aur warzish mein dimagh ka control centre dono ko nerve signals bhej kar raftar barhata hai; neend ya aaraam mein in ki activity dheemi karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Brain also exerts some influence on heart rate.

blocks.prompt:
17 Differentiate between the P wave and the T wave of an ECG.
(ECG ki P wave aur T wave mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono normal ECG ki waves hain.

book_ref.quote: T wave abnormalities may indicate electrolyte disturbance.

rows: Atrial depolarization ki shuruat (SA node se)
Ventricles ki repolarization ki shuruat
Atria ko sukarati hai
ST segment ke baad aati hai
Be-qaida ya ghayab P waves arrhythmia dikha sakti hain
Kharabi electrolyte ki gharbar dikha sakti hai; hyper-acute T wave acute myocardial infarction ki pehli nishani

blocks.prompt:
18 What is the QT interval? What is its normal value?
(QT interval kya hai? Is ki normal qeemat kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: ECG ka QT interval QRS complex ki shuruat se T wave ke aakhir tak naapa jata hai. Normal QT interval aam tor par taqreeban 0.40 second hota hai.

book_ref.quote: The QT interval is from the beginning of the QRS complex to the end of the T wave.

blocks.prompt:
19 What does the ST segment show? What do its changes indicate?
(ST segment kya dikhata hai? Is ki tabdeeliyan kis baat ki nishani hain?)
blocks.explanation: ST segment ventricles ki depolarization ki takmeel dikhata hai aur taqreeban 0.08 second ka hai. Ischemia (dil ke muscles ko khoon aur oxygen ki kami) mein yeh neeche aur myocardial infarction mein upar hota hai.

book_ref.quote: elevated in myocardial infarction

blocks.prompt:
20 Who are blue babies? What causes their blueness?
(Blue babies kaun hain? Un ke neele pan ki wajah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Blue babies woh ghair mamooli naumolood bachay hain jin ki jild neeli (cyanosis) hoti hai. Interatrial foramen band na hone ya ductus arteriosus ke tang na hone se oxygen wala aur baghair oxygen ka khoon mil jata hai aur jism ko mila jula khoon milta hai.

book_ref.quote: They are called blue babies.

blocks.prompt:
21 Differentiate between interatrial foramen and ductus arteriosus.
(Interatrial foramen aur ductus arteriosus mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono embryo ke circulation ki aarzi banawatein hain.

book_ref.quote: Interatrial foramen is a temporary opening in the embryonic heart

rows: Embryo ke dil mein daayen aur baayen atrium ke darmiyan aarzi surakh
Embryo ki pulmonary artery aur aorta ke darmiyan aarzi raasta
Aam tor par nashonuma mein band ho jata hai
Aam tor par nashonuma mein tang ho kar band ho jata hai
Band na ho to cyanosis
Poora tang na ho to bhi cyanosis

blocks.prompt:
22 How are capillaries formed, and what do they join to form?
(Capillaries kaise banti hain aur mil kar kya banati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Arteries arterioles mein aur arterioles baar baar batt kar bareek shakhon ka ghana jaal, capillaries, banati hain. Capillaries tamam tissues mein jati hain aur phir mil kar venules banati hain.

book_ref.quote: These vessels are formed by the division of arterioles.

blocks.prompt:
23 How do materials pass across the capillary wall?
(Capillary ki deewar se cheezein kaise guzarti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Capillaries khoon aur tissues mein diffusion ya active transport se tabadla karti hain. Cheezein endothelial cells ke andar se ya deewar ke cells ke darmiyani khalaon se guzarti hain; kuch endocytosis se andar aa kar exocytosis se doosri taraf nikalti hain.

book_ref.quote: Materials pass through the endothelial cells or through the intercellular spaces

blocks.prompt:
24 What is interstitial fluid? How is it formed?
(Interstitial fluid kya hai? Yeh kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Capillaries ke andar ka pressure blood plasma se fluid ko musalsal tissues mein rasata hai. Yahi interstitial fluid hai: paani jis mein ghuli ghiza, hormones, gases, fuzlaat aur chhote proteins hain.

book_ref.quote: This fluid, known as interstitial fluid consists of water

blocks.prompt:
25 Give reason: RBCs stay in capillaries but some WBCs can leave them.
(Wajah batayein: RBCs capillaries mein rehte hain magar kuch WBCs bahar nikal sakte hain.)
blocks.explanation: Bare proteins, RBCs aur platelets capillary ki deewar se nahi guzar sakte, is liye andar rehte hain. Kuch WBCs deewar ke cells ke darmiyani khalaon se dab kar tissues mein nikal jate hain.

book_ref.quote: But some WBCs can squeeze out

blocks.prompt:
26 How do surrounding muscles and valves help the return of blood in veins?
(Aas paas ke muscles aur valves veins mein khoon ki wapsi mein kaise madad dete hain?)
blocks.explanation: Aas paas ke muscles ke sukarne ka dabao veins ko dabata aur khoon ko dil ki taraf dhakelta hai. Veins ke semilunar valves is khoon ko wapas behne se rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: assists in the return of blood towards heart

blocks.prompt:
27 How is the amount of blood flowing in capillaries controlled?
(Capillaries mein behne wale khoon ki miqdaar kaise control hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Capillaries ko tang ya chaura kar ke: nervous stimulation unhein tang aur histamine jaise chemicals chaura karte hain. Pre-capillary sphincters (capillary loops ke dakhle par muscles ke chhalle) bhi bahao control karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Nervous stimulation can constrict capillaries

blocks.prompt:
28 Give reason: blood flow increases in a tissue whose metabolic activity rises.
(Wajah batayein: jis tissue ki metabolic activity barhe us mein khoon ka bahao barh jata hai.)
blocks.explanation: Metabolic activity barhne par interstitial fluid mein oxygen kam aur carbon dioxide zyada hoti hai. Jawab mein arterioles ke circular muscles dheele ho kar phailte hain (vasodilation), khoon ka bahao barhta hai, zyada oxygen aati aur zyada carbon dioxide nikalti hai.

book_ref.quote: The increased blood flow supplies more oxygen and removes more carbon dioxide.

blocks.prompt:
29 Differentiate between pulmonary circulation and systemic circulation.
(Pulmonary aur systemic circulation mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono khoon ke daure ke bare raste hain.

book_ref.quote: These are called pulmonary circulation (to and from lungs)

rows: Phephron tak aur wapas
Phephron ke siwa baqi jism tak aur wapas
Daayen ventricle (pulmonary trunk) se shuru
Baayen ventricle (aorta) se shuru
Deoxygenated khoon phephron ko le jata aur oxygenated wapas lata hai
Oxygenated khoon jism ko deta aur deoxygenated wapas lata hai
Baayen atrium (pulmonary veins) par khatam
Daayen atrium (vena cavae) par khatam

blocks.prompt:
30 What is the coronary sinus?
(Coronary sinus kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Coronary capillaries dil ke muscles ko khoon de kar venules aur coronary veins banati hain. Coronary veins mil kar coronary sinus banati hain jo daayen atrium mein khulta hai; chhoti coronary veins seedhi daayen atrium mein girti hain.

book_ref.quote: The coronary veins join to form a coronary sinus, which opens in right atrium.

blocks.prompt:
31 What is a portal system? Give an example.
(Portal system kya hai? Misaal dein.)
blocks.explanation: Portal system woh circulation hai jis mein veins capillaries par khatam hoti hain. Misaal: hepatic portal system, jis mein hepatic portal vein spleen aur alimentary canal se khoon le kar jigar tak le jati hai.

book_ref.quote: A portal system is a circulation in which veins end in capillaries.

blocks.prompt:
32 Give reason: blood from the alimentary canal passes through the liver before going to the heart.
(Wajah batayein: alimentary canal ka khoon dil jane se pehle jigar se guzarta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Is khoon mein chhoti aant se jazb hone wali cheezein hoti hain. Jigar is se nuqsan deh cheezein nikalta aur ghiza zakheere ke liye jazb karta hai, phir khoon hepatic veins ke zariye dil ko jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Liver removes harmful substances from blood

blocks.prompt:
33 Differentiate between afferent and efferent arterioles of the kidney.
(Gurde ki afferent aur efferent arterioles mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono renal circulation ki arterioles hain.

book_ref.quote: The capillaries of glomeruli unite to make efferent arteriole

rows: Renal artery ki chhoti arteries ki shakh
Glomerulus ki capillaries ke milne se banti hai
Nephron ko khoon deti hai
Glomerulus se khoon le jati hai
Batt kar glomerulus ki capillaries banati hai
Peri-tubular capillaries aur vasa recta mein batt'ti hai

blocks.prompt:
34 Differentiate between peri-tubular capillaries and vasa recta.
(Peri-tubular capillaries aur vasa recta mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono efferent arteriole se bante hain.

book_ref.quote: peri-tubular capillaries (around nephron tubule in cortical portion of kidney)

rows: Gurde ke cortex mein nephron tubule ke gird
Gurde ke medulla mein nephron tubule ke gird
Efferent arteriole ki capillaries ka aik set
Efferent arteriole ki capillaries ka doosra set

blocks.prompt:
35 What is pulse? Why is it felt in arteries?
(Pulse (nabz) kya hai? Yeh arteries mein kyun mehsoos hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pulse khoon ke bahao se arteries ki baqaida dhak dhak hai. Yeh arteries mein is liye mehsoos hoti hai ke un ki deewarein lachakdar hain aur har ventricular contraction par khoon un mein zyada pressure se dhakela jata hai.

book_ref.quote: The walls of arteries are elastic.

blocks.prompt:
36 What does a blood pressure reading of 120/80 mean?
(Blood pressure ki reading 120/80 ka kya matlab hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upar wala adad (120 mm Hg) systolic pressure hai, yani ventricular systole ka zyada se zyada pressure. Neeche wala adad (80 mm Hg) diastolic pressure hai, yani agle ventricular contraction se pehle arteries mein baqi sab se kam pressure.

book_ref.quote: Conventionally, the readings of blood pressure are expressed as 120/80.

blocks.prompt:
37 What is a sphygmomanometer? How does it show readings?
(Sphygmomanometer kya hai? Yeh readings kaise dikhata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sphygmomanometer systolic aur diastolic blood pressure haath se naapne ka aala hai. Is ke mercury column ka uthna aur girna readings dikhata hai.

book_ref.quote: rise and fall in mercury column shows the readings

blocks.prompt:
38 Differentiate between ADH and ANH in the regulation of blood pressure.
(Blood pressure ke control mein ADH aur ANH mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono khoon ke hajm aur pressure ko lambe arse tak control karne wale hormones hain.

book_ref.quote: When there is stretching of the atrium by an increased blood volume

rows: Posterior pituitary gland se
Daayen atrium ki deewar ke endocrine cells se
Khoon ka hajm aur pressure kam hone par
Khoon ka hajm barh kar atrium khinchne par
Gurde zyada paani rokte hain; arterioles tang hoti hain
Peshab se namak aur paani ka ikhraj tez karta hai
Hajm aur pressure barhata hai
Hajm aur pressure kam karta hai

blocks.prompt:
39 Differentiate between atherosclerosis and arteriosclerosis.
(Atherosclerosis aur arteriosclerosis mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono cardiovascular bimariyon ki bari wajahen hain.

book_ref.quote: Atherosclerosis and arteriosclerosis are the major contributors to cardiovascular disorders.

rows: Arteries ke andar jamao
Arteries ki deewaron ka sakht hona
Charbi, smooth muscle cells, cholesterol, fibrin aur malba jama; cholesterol sab se bari wajah
Arteries ki deewaron mein calcium jama

Bahao kam; arteries phail nahi saktin, dil ko zyada mehnat
Shadeed hone par arteriosclerosis ka sabab
Aam tor par shadeed atherosclerosis ke baad

blocks.prompt:
40 Give reason: atherosclerosis can lead to heart attacks.
(Wajah batayein: atherosclerosis heart attack ka sabab ban sakta hai.)
blocks.explanation: Atherosclerosis arteries ko tang karta aur thrombus banne ka khatra barhata hai. Tang ya band coronary artery dil ke muscle ko kaafi khoon nahi de sakti, jis se heart attack ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Atherosclerosis can lead to heart attacks

blocks.prompt:
41 What is an angiogram? What does a narrow artery in it indicate?
(Angiogram kya hai? Is mein tang artery kis baat ki nishani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angiogram coronary angiography mein coronary artery ke andar contrast medium (dye) ki X-ray tasweer hai. Agar artery ke lumen mein clots hon to angiogram mein woh tang nazar aati hai.

book_ref.quote: Pictures (angiograms) of fluid in coronary artery are obtained.

blocks.prompt:
42 What is angina pectoris? What does it indicate?
(Angina pectoris kya hai? Yeh kis baat ki nishani hai?)
blocks.explanation: Angina pectoris seene ka dard hai jo lipids jama hone se tang coronary arteries ki surat mein dabao ya jismani mehnat ke waqt hota hai. Yeh batata hai ke dil ki oxygen ki maang supply se zyada hai aur aage heart attack ho sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: chest pain, called angina pectoris, can result

blocks.prompt:
43 When is recovery from a heart attack possible?
(Heart attack se sehat yabi kab mumkin hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sehat yabi tab mumkin hai jab dil ka nuqsan zada hissa itna chhota ho ke dil ki doosri blood vessels apni gunjaish barha kar nuqsan zada tissues ko dobara khoon pohancha saken.

book_ref.quote: Recovery from a heart attack is possible

blocks.prompt:
44 Give reason: lifestyle changes are needed even after a successful bypass surgery.
(Wajah batayein: kamyab bypass surgery ke baad bhi lifestyle badalna zaroori hai.)
blocks.explanation: Bypass surgery sirf khoon ko rukawat ke gird ghuma deti hai; yeh asal bimari atherosclerosis ya coronary artery disease ka ilaj nahi. Smoking chhorna, kuch charbiyan kam karna, zyada jismani harkat aur blood pressure aur diabetes control karna aainda rukawat aur heart attack kam karta hai.

book_ref.quote: Coronary bypass surgery doesn't cure the underlying disease process

blocks.prompt:
45 What is a stent? Write its role.
(Stent kya hai? Is ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Stent phailne wali stainless steel ki jaali dar nali hai jo balloon catheter par lagi hoti hai. Tang artery mein balloon phulane se stent aur artery phailti hain; balloon nikal liya jata hai aur stent reh kar artery ki deewaron ko sahara deta aur use khula rakhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The stent supports the artery walls

blocks.prompt:
46 Write the causes of hypertension.
(Hypertension ki wajahen likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Blood pressure control karne wale nervous ya hormonal nizam ki koi kharabi hypertension paida kar sakti hai. Doosri wajahen: dabao (stress), motapa, zyada namak aur smoking; moroosi (hereditary) wajahen bhi ho sakti hain.

book_ref.quote: Other causes of hypertension include stress, obesity

blocks.prompt:
47 Differentiate between brain haemorrhage and congestive heart failure.
(Brain haemorrhage aur congestive heart failure mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono musalsal hypertension ka nateeja ho sakte hain.

book_ref.quote: In such conditions, blood may be retained in heart and lungs.

rows: Dimagh ki blood vessels ka phatna
Dil theek tarah pump nahi kar pata
Musalsal barhe hue blood pressure se
Lambe hypertension se dil ke muscles kamzor hone se
Dimagh ki nazuk banawat ko nuqsan
Khoon dil aur phephron mein ruk jata hai; tissues ki zaroorat poori nahi hoti

blocks.prompt:
48 Write the causes of thrombus formation.
(Thrombus banne ki wajahen likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Thrombus in wajahon se ban sakta hai: (1) blood vessels ki andaruni tah ki irritation ya infection; (2) lambe arse ki be-harkati se khoon ke bahao ka kam hona; (3) pneumonia, tuberculosis aur emphysema jaisi bimariyan.

book_ref.quote: Thrombus formation may be due to

blocks.prompt:
49 What is thromboembolism?
(Thromboembolism kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Thromboembolism blood vessel mein thrombus (lothra) banna aur phir circulatory system mein kisi aur jagah le jaya jana hai, jahan yeh khoon ka bahao rok sakta hai.

book_ref.quote: Formation of thrombus in a blood vessel and then its carriage to any other location is called thromboembolism.

blocks.prompt:
50 What is lymph? How is it formed?
(Lymph kya hai? Yeh kaise banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lymph lymphatic system mein behne wala fluid hai. Interstitial fluid ka pressure use band siron wali lymph capillaries mein dhakelta hai; lymph capillaries mein dakhil hone ke baad interstitial fluid lymph kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: When interstitial fluid enters lymph capillaries, it is called lymph.

blocks.prompt:
51 Differentiate between lymph capillaries and blood capillaries.
(Lymph capillaries aur blood capillaries mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono tissues mein bareek naliyan hain.

book_ref.quote: So, larger molecules can also enter lymph capillaries.

rows: Interstitial fluid mein band sire
Arterioles se banti aur mil kar venules banati hain
Zyada permeable; bare molecules andar ja sakte hain
Kam permeable; bare proteins, RBCs aur platelets andar rehte hain
Lymph le jati hain
Khoon le jati hain

blocks.prompt:
52 Differentiate between the right lymphatic duct and the thoracic duct.
(Right lymphatic duct aur thoracic duct mein farq likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Dono lymph vessels ke milne se banne wali bari lymph ducts hain.

book_ref.quote: There are two main lymph ducts i.e., right lymphatic duct and thoracic duct.

rows: Daayen subclavian vein mein khulti hai
Baayen subclavian vein mein khulti hai
Do bari lymph ducts mein se aik
Jism ke tissues se lymph hamesha isi ki taraf behta hai

blocks.prompt:
53 How is the flow of lymph maintained in one direction?
(Lymph ka bahao aik hi simt mein kaise qaim rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lymph hamesha jism ke tissues se thoracic duct ki taraf behta hai. Yeh bahao skeletal muscles ki harkat, andaruni aaza ki harkat aur saans ki harkat se qaim rehta hai, aur lymph vessels ke valves use wapas behne se rokte hain.

book_ref.quote: The valves present in lymph vessels prevent the back flow of lymph.

blocks.prompt:
54 What are lacteals? What enters them?
(Lacteals kya hain? In mein kya dakhil hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lacteals villi mein lymph capillaries ki shakhein hain. Villi ke cells mein jazb fatty acids aur glycerol triglycerides banate hain jin par protein chadh kar chylomicrons bante hain; yeh chylomicrons lacteals mein jate hain.

book_ref.quote: Fatty acids and glycerol are absorbed into the epithelial cells of villi

blocks.prompt:
55 What are lymph nodes? Where are they found in man?
(Lymph nodes kya hain? Insan mein yeh kahan hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Lymph nodes lymph vessels par kuch jaghon par connective tissue ke dher hain jin mein lymphocytes hote hain. Kayi afferent vessels node mein aati aur aik efferent vessel lymph bahar le jati hai. Yeh gardan, bagal (axilla) aur groin mein hote hain.

book_ref.quote: At certain spots, the lymph vessels have masses of connective tissue

blocks.prompt:
56 Name the lymphoid masses of the body and write their function.
(Jism ke lymphoid masses ke naam aur un ka kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: Lymphoid masses alimentary canal ki mucosa aur submucosa mein hain; bare masses spleen, thymus, tonsils aur adenoids hain. Yeh lymphocytes banate hain.

book_ref.quote: In addition to lymph nodes, several lymphoid masses are present

blocks.prompt:
57 Write two functions of the lymphatic system.
(Lymphatic system ke do kaam likhein.)
blocks.explanation: (1) Yeh izafi fluid, ghule proteins aur doosri cheezein wapas khoon mein lata hai: roz taqreeban teen litre fluid jo blood capillaries se nikalta hai, lymph capillaries jazb kar ke khoon mein wapas late hain. (2) Yeh jism ko bairooni hamla awaron se bachata hai: lymph nodes lymph saaf karte hain aur un ke lymphocytes aur macrophages bacteria aur viruses khatam karte hain.

book_ref.quote: Lymphatic system returns the excess fluid and dissolved proteins

blocks.prompt:
58 What is the role of the spleen?
(Spleen ka kya kirdar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Spleen apne macrophages aur lymphocytes se khoon saaf karta hai jo bairooni zarrat aur purane RBCs khatam karte hain. Yeh RBCs jama bhi karta hai aur bara lymphoid mass hone ki wajah se lymphocytes banata hai.

book_ref.quote: Spleen filters blood through its macrophages

blocks.prompt:
59 Give reason: lymph nodes swell painfully in diseases such as mumps.
(Wajah batayein: mumps jaisi bimariyon mein lymph nodes dard ke saath soojh jate hain.)
blocks.explanation: Lymph nodes mein lymphocytes aur macrophages hote hain jo hamla awaron ko khatam karte hain. Mumps jaisi bimariyon mein lymph nodes ki dard bhari soojan zyada tar murda lymphocytes aur macrophages ke jama hone se hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: The painful swelling of lymph nodes in certain diseases
